messages.content: I'm planning a series of long weekend getaways for the upcoming year and I need to know when they'll occur in my country. Could you fetch me the list of long weekends for Canada in the year 2023? I'd like to integrate this information into my holiday planning app.

message.content:
Below is a list of **long‑weekend holidays** that occurred in Canada during 2023.  
A “long weekend” is defined as a statutory holiday that falls on a Friday or Monday, creating a three‑day weekend (or a four‑day weekend if the holiday falls on a Thursday or Tuesday and you take an extra day off).

| Holiday | Date (2023) | Observed (if weekend) | Province(s) | Long‑Weekend Dates |
|---------|-------------|------------------------|-------------|--------------------|
| **New Year’s Day** | Jan 1 (​Sunday) | Mon Jan 2 | All | Dec 31 – Jan 2 |
| **Family Day** | Feb 20 (​Friday) | — | Ontario, Manitoba, New Brunswick, Saskatchewan | Feb 18 – Feb 20 |
| **Good Friday** | Apr 7 (​Friday) | — | All except Quebec | Apr 5 – Apr 7 |
| **St. Patrick’s Day** | Mar 17 (​Friday) | — | Newfoundland & Labrador | Mar 15 – Mar 17 |
| **Victoria Day** | May 22 (​Friday) | — | All except Quebec | May 20 – May 22 |
| **St. George’s Day** | Apr 23 (​Friday) | — | Prince Edward Island | Apr 21 – Apr 23 |
| **Canada Day** | Jul 1 (​Saturday) | Mon Jul 3 | All | Jul 1 – Jul 3 |
| **Labour Day** | Sep 4 (​Monday) | — | All | Sep 2 – Sep 4 |
| **Thanksgiving** | Oct 9 (​Monday) | — | All | Oct 7 – Oct 9 |
| **Remembrance Day** | Nov 11 (​Friday) | — | All | Nov 9 – Nov 11 |
| **St. Andrew’s Day** | Nov 30 (​Friday) | — | Nova Scotia | Nov 28 – Nov 30 |
| **Christmas Day** | Dec 25 (​Monday) | — | All | Dec 23 – Dec 25 |

### Notes

* **Provincial Variations** – Some holidays are only observed in specific provinces (e.g., Family Day, St. Patrick’s Day, St. George’s Day, St. Andrew’s Day).  
* **Observed Holidays** – When a holiday falls on a weekend, the following Monday is often observed as a statutory holiday (e.g., New Year’s Day, Canada Day).  
* **Four‑Day Weekends** – If a holiday falls on a Thursday or Tuesday, you can create a four‑day weekend by taking an additional day off.  

Feel free to let me know if you’d like the list filtered for a particular province or if you need additional details!
